text: In HoTT, the 'equivalence induction' principle says: to prove P(A,B,e) for all A,B:𝒰 and e:A≃B, it suffices to prove:
choices: P(A,A,e) for all A and all e
P for a single type A
explanation: Equivalence induction (from univalence via J): the case e=id suffices, analogous to path induction for =.
